makemeahanzi.definition: bullet, pellet, shell; elastic, springy

characterDeckComponents.note: 弓 (bow) — 弹 relates to a projectile shot from a bow, like a pellet
单 (dān) gives a loose sound connection to 弹's reading dàn

makemeahanzi.definition: tent, screen, mosquito net; debt, credit, account

characterDeckComponents.note: 巾 (cloth) shows 帐 relates to something made of fabric, like a tent or curtain.
长 (zhǎng) gives a sound close to zhàng, sharing the initial consonant.

makemeahanzi.definition: degree, system; manner; to consider

etymology.hint: Twenty 廿 people 又 meeting inside a building 广 to deliberate

characterDeckComponents.note: 广 (a building or shelter) — 度 pictures people gathering indoors.
廿 (twenty) — a group of people meeting to measure or deliberate gave 度 its meaning of a 'degree' or 'measure,' as in temperature or angles.

makemeahanzi.definition: back, backside; to betray, to violate

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh/body) — 背 refers to the back, a part of the body
北 (běi) gives a sound close to 背's reading bèi, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

meanings: see 節骨眼|节骨眼[jie1 gu5 yan3]

makemeahanzi.definition: festival; knot, joint; segment; to economize, to save

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 節; sections of bamboo ⺮

characterDeckComponents.note: 节 is the simplified form of 節, which depicted the segmented sections of a bamboo stalk ⺮ — giving 节 its meaning 'joint, section, festival.'

makemeahanzi.definition: row, rank, file; to eliminate, to remove

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 排 relates to arranging things by hand into order
非 (fēi) gives a sound distantly related to 排's reading pái, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: pig, hog, wild boar

characterDeckComponents.note: Animal — shows this word refers to an animal.
Gives the sound zhě, related to zhū but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to follow, to listen to, to submit to

etymology.hint: To walk 迶 to the city 阝; to follow a path

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a mound/city) — represents a place being traveled to.
迶 depicts walking or moving along a path — following someone to the city gave 随 its meaning 'to follow, along with.'

meanings: newton (abbr. for 牛頓|牛顿[niu2 dun4])

makemeahanzi.definition: ox, cow, bull

characterDeckComponents.note: The character traces the front view of an ox's head, with the top stroke and crossing lines representing its curved horns and ears.

makemeahanzi.definition: bottle, jug, pitcher, vase

characterDeckComponents.note: 瓦 (tile, earthenware) shows 瓶 is typically made of ceramic or glass.
并 (bìng) gives a sound close to píng, differing mainly in the initial consonant.

makemeahanzi.definition: to inhale, to suck in; to absorb; to attract

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 吸 describes breathing in through the mouth.
及 (jí) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading xī has diverged.

makemeahanzi.definition: to marry, to give a daughter in marriage

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 嫁 specifically describes a woman marrying.
家 (jiā) gives the sound — a close match for jià, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: seven
vegetables; order, dish; food

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (plant) — 菜 names something grown, a vegetable.
采 (cǎi) gives a sound close to cài, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to alter, to change, to improve, to remodel

etymology.hint: A hand with a stick 攵 disciplining a kneeling child 己

characterDeckComponents.note: 己 (a kneeling child) — the one being disciplined.
攵 (a hand with a stick) — correcting the child, giving 改 its meaning 'to change, correct, reform.'

makemeahanzi.definition: thought, idea, opinion; desire, wish; meaning, intention

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart/mind) — 意 relates to thought, intention, and meaning, things of the mind.
音 (yīn) is the historical phonetic element; its modern reading has drifted from yì, though both share a similar vowel.

makemeahanzi.definition: to earn, to profit, to make money

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (shell, an ancient form of money) — 赚 relates to earning money.
兼 (jiān) gives a sound distantly related to 赚's reading zhuàn, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: not, negative, non-; to oppose

etymology.hint: Two bird's wings opposed; two people back-to-back

characterDeckComponents.note: Depicts two things splayed apart from each other — such as a bird's two wings, or two people standing back-to-back — later used for the meaning 'not, contrary to.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to hold in the mouth; bite

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — the mouth radical, marking the character as related to speech, sound, or an action of the mouth.
吾 (wú) gives the sound — an exact match with 唔's reading.

makemeahanzi.definition: first; dollar; origin; head

etymology.hint: A man 儿 with two lines emphasizing their head 二

characterDeckComponents.note: 儿 (a standing person) — the figure being emphasized.
二 (an extra line at the top) — emphasizing the person's head, the 'first, foremost' part of them — the source of 元's meanings 'origin, first' and, by extension, the basic unit of Chinese currency.

makemeahanzi.definition: to knit, to weave; to arrange, to compile

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 编 originally described weaving or knitting threads together.
扁 (biǎn) gives a sound close to biān, with the tone shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: war, fighting, battle

characterDeckComponents.note: 戈 (a dagger-axe, a weapon) — 战 relates to fighting and war.
占 (zhàn) gives the sound — 战 is also pronounced zhàn, an exact match.

makemeahanzi.definition: Asia; second

etymology.hint: Picture of a cross-shaped house or temple

characterDeckComponents.note: A pictograph of a cross-shaped building, possibly an altar or temple floor plan; the character was later adopted to write 'Asia' (亚洲) and the unrelated meaning 'second, next.'

makemeahanzi.definition: play, show, theater

etymology.hint: A hand 又 doing tricks with a spear 戈

characterDeckComponents.note: 又 (hand) shows a hand performing an action.
戈 (spear) — mock combat and stage tricks with weapons gave 戏 its meaning 'play, drama.'

meanings: to get up or sit up

makemeahanzi.definition: to climb, to scramble; to crawl, to creep

characterDeckComponents.note: 爪 (claw) — 爬 describes crawling or climbing using claws, or hands and feet.
巴 (bā) shares the rhyme -a and a related bilabial initial (b/p) with pá, just the tone differs.

makemeahanzi.definition: to bet, to gamble, to wager

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (money) — gambling involves staking money.
者 (zhě) gives a sound distantly related to dǔ, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to vomit, to spew out, to cough up; to say

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) shows 吐 relates to an action of the mouth.
土 (tǔ) gives the exact sound of 吐.

makemeahanzi.definition: to blend, to mix; to fit, to match

characterDeckComponents.note: 酉 (a wine vessel) — 配 originally related to blending or mixing wine
己 (jǐ) gives a sound distantly related to 配's reading pèi, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: words, language; saying, expression

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 语 relates to language, words, and speech
吾 (wú) gives a loose sound connection to 语's reading yǔ

makemeahanzi.definition: silk, fine thread; wire; strings

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 絲, two threads

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 丝 is a simplified picture of two twisted strands of silk thread.

makemeahanzi.definition: yet, still; keeping, continuing; again

characterDeckComponents.note: 乃 (then, thus) — 仍 relates to continuity, 'still, as before'
亻 gives a loose sound connection to 仍's reading réng

meanings: (bound form) foster (as in 寄女[ji4 nu : 3] foster daughter)

makemeahanzi.definition: to mail, to send, to transit; to deposit, to entrust; to rely on

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof) shows 寄 relates to a household, as in sending something from home.
奇 (qí) gives a sound distantly related to jì, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: device, instrument, tool; receptacle, vessel

etymology.hint: Four cooking vessels 口 guarded by a dog 犬

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (a vessel), shown four times — a set of cooking vessels.
犬 (a dog) — guarding the vessels, the source of 器's meaning 'vessel, tool, instrument.'

makemeahanzi.definition: somewhat, slightly, at least

characterDeckComponents.note: 耳 (ear) — chatting involves listening as well as speaking.
卯 (mǎo) gives a sound distantly related to liáo, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: mother; young girl; woman; wife

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 娘 names a female relative, mother or young woman.
良 (liáng) gives a sound close to niáng, sharing the same rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: insane, mad; violent; wild

characterDeckComponents.note: 犭 (dog) — 狂 originally described a mad, rabid dog, extending to 'wild, crazy.'
王 (wáng) gives a sound distantly related to kuáng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to drag, to haul, to tow; to delay

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 拖 describes pulling or dragging something by hand.

makemeahanzi.definition: to blow, to puff; to brag, to boast

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 吹 describes blowing air out of the mouth.
欠 (qiàn) is only distantly related in sound to chuī — the connection has drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to injure, to harm; to destroy, to kill
to study; to repair; to decorate; to cultivate

characterDeckComponents.note: 彡 (hair/decorative strokes) — 修 relates to grooming, decorating, or improving something
攸 (yōu) gives a sound close to 修's reading xiū, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: anxious, worried; hasty, quick; pressing, urgent

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart/mind) — 急 relates to an anxious or urgent state of mind
刍 (chú) gives a sound distantly related to 急's reading jí, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: wind; air; customs, manners; news
to play, to frolic, to amuse

etymology.hint: A woman 女 wearing a beard 而 for disguise

characterDeckComponents.note: 而 (a beard) suggests a mask or disguise worn over the face.
女 (woman) sits below it — a woman wearing a disguise as part of a performance, giving 耍 its meaning 'to play, to frolic.'

makemeahanzi.definition: gauze, net; to collect, to display

characterDeckComponents.note: 罒 (net) — relates to 罗's original meaning 'net for catching birds,' extended to 'to gather, collect' and used today as a common Chinese surname.

makemeahanzi.definition: low; to lower, to hang; to bend, to bow

characterDeckComponents.note: 氐 (dī) gives the sound — 低 is also pronounced dī, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: leftovers, residue, remains

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) — 剩 originally involved cutting away a surplus portion, giving 'to remain, leftover.'
乘 (chéng) shares the rhyme -eng and a related retroflex initial (ch/sh) with shèng — only the tone differs.

makemeahanzi.definition: meal, food; cooked rice

characterDeckComponents.note: 饣 (food) — 饭 names cooked rice, a meal.
反 (fǎn) gives the sound — an exact match with 饭.

makemeahanzi.definition: brain

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh/body) — 脑 refers to the brain, a part of the body

makemeahanzi.definition: to bother, to trouble, to vex

characterDeckComponents.note: 火 (fire) — 烦 describes a burning, irritated feeling.
页 (yè) gives a sound distantly related to fán, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: tune, melody, key; to transfer, to exchange

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — relates to 调's meaning 'to adjust, transfer,' something coordinated through spoken negotiation.
周 (zhōu) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from diào.
